examples.text: He pulled the thick duvet over his head to block out the morning light.

raw_glosses: (British, Ireland, New Zealand, Canada) A quilt or usually flat cloth bag with a filling (traditionally down) and usually an additional washable cover, used instead of blankets; often called a comforter or quilt, especially in US English.
